features.title: Living shield
features.text: Guardians wear medium or heavy armor to resist physical damage and stay close enough to protect their allies.

features.title: Taunt and intercept
features.text: Taunt penalizes enemies that attack allies instead of the guardian. Intercept Attack lets a guardian step beside a nearby ally and take physical damage in their place.
